speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation, Dr. Agent here. I see you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; tell me, how many days postpartum are you, and have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible Urinary Tract Infection.

I have noted your history of prolonged labor, increased urination frequency, and uterine tenderness. Given the combination of fever, abdominal/uterine tenderness, and decreased bowel sounds, I need to confirm your vital signs and check your white blood cell count. REQUEST TEST: CBC with Differential, CRP, Urinalysis with Culture, and Blood Culture.
